About WindyCityWares

We make cremation urns and keepsakes that look like the life they hold, so the place where you keep a loved one feels like them.

Our mission

Choosing an urn usually happens in the hardest week of a family’s life. We want that choice to be simple and the result to be something you are glad to see every day: a lighthouse for someone who loved the coast, a ball field for a lifelong fan, a sky full of stars for someone who looked up.

Each design is printed on the urn itself and paired with matching keepsakes, so brothers, sisters and children can each keep a part of the person they miss.

Our story

WindyCityWares began as a shop on Etsy, WindyCityWaresUS. As the number of designs grew past a hundred, we opened our own store at shop.windycitywares.com, where every design is organized into collections and easier to compare.

The name comes from home. We work from Schaumburg, Illinois, a short drive from downtown Chicago, the Windy City.

Materials

Aluminum body
Light to hold and strong enough to keep for generations.
High-gloss enamel
The artwork is sealed under a smooth, glossy enamel finish.
Threaded screw-top lid
The lid screws closed, so the ashes stay sealed and safe.
Two sizes
A 6 × 10 inch urn for adult ashes, and 1.5 × 3 inch keepsakes for sharing.
